learn_truth: Purpose gives meaning to effort—it answers the question of why your actions matter.

learn_headline: Meaning is not found—it is created by how you live
learn_truth: Meaning emerges from connection, contribution, and pursuit of something beyond yourself.

learn_headline: Ethics is thinking about right and wrong before you act
learn_truth: Ethics examines how we should act—principles for navigating moral choices.

learn_headline: Values are invisible until choices make them visible
learn_truth: Values are principles that guide decisions—revealed by choices, especially difficult ones.

learn_topic: Who You Are When No One's Looking
learn_headline: Identity is who you are when nobody is watching
learn_truth: Character is who you are when no one is watching—the sum of your habitual choices.

learn_headline: Legacy is what remains when you are gone—make it worth remembering
learn_truth: Legacy is the impact that outlasts you—what remains when you are gone.

learn_headline: Reflection turns experience into wisdom—without it, years teach nothing
learn_truth: Reflection extracts lessons from experience—without it, we repeat mistakes instead of learning.

learn_headline: Celebration marks moments worth remembering—do not skip them
learn_truth: Celebration marks milestones, reinforcing their importance and creating shared memories.

learn_headline: Gratitude rewires your brain to notice what is good instead of what is missing
learn_truth: Gratitude shifts focus from what's missing to what's present—improving wellbeing measurably.

learn_headline: Every ending is also a beginning—today is always day one if you decide it is
learn_truth: Fresh starts provide psychological permission to change—the calendar creates natural reset points.

learn_headline: Growth is invisible daily but undeniable yearly—keep going
learn_truth: Growth happens gradually—small daily improvements compound into transformative change.
